row: Dr. Kara Caldwell, aka the Cat Repairwoman, has been a feline-only veterinarian since graduating veterinary school in 2011.  The aim of this channel is to give informative advice for fellow cat owners, but also with tips and tricks that Dr. Caldwell has learned over the years both as a cat owner and as a veterinarian.  She will be joined by her "catsistants" Obie, Scoots, and Tuna as they see fit (in true cat fashion).  In memory of Maggie, Columbus, and Mercy who helped shape who she is today as both a better, more experienced cat owner and a veterinarian.
